notes.title: Major Update 1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]NEW FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]Laser cannon is now aimed with the mouse in a small arc ahead of the player[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added the ability to target other ships (right click by default)[/p][/*][*][p]Missiles/torpedoes track the player's selected target[/p][/*][*][p]Added an ammo counter to the UI for remaining warheads[/p][/*][*][p]There are now 3 firing modes for the laser cannon (1, 2, and 3 keys by default) [/p][p]- The three modes change the fire rate and damage output of the laser cannon [/p][p]- These modes can also be cycled through (X key by default)[/p][/*][*][p]You can now use a full energy bar to instantly charge shields to full (Q key by default)[/p][/*][*][p]Completely rebuilt campaign system with better mission generation[/p][/*][*][p]User interface totally overhauled for the campaign[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]There are now space stations; these are immobile, but well defended[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Several new ship types added [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player can now select different secondary weapon loadouts [/p][p]- Missiles; these work the same as before; good against fighters; you now get 6 [/p][p]- Torpedoes; slower and less maneuverable, but stronger than missiles[/p][p]- Heavy Bombs; adopt the launching craft's speed and are unguided, but extremely powerful[/p][p]- Plasma Rockets; unguided, very fast warheads; low damage, but can carry 20[/p][p]- Photon Disks; unlimited, but takes significant energy to fire; moderate damage[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Visual effects added for jump drive and afterburner use[/p][/*][*][p]How to play option added for new players[/p][/*][*][p]Added music to the main menu so it isn't eerily silent[/p][/*][*][p]Tech library now contains data on weapons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed certain menu buttons not working on monitors with resolution above 1920x1080[/p][/*][*][p]Removed sliver of green showing up on health bar of dead fighters after mission[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with target selection for turrets[/p][/*][*][p]Jump drive can no longer charge after player is killed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos in the tech library[/p][/*][*][p]Player now fails the campaign for leaving a mission early[/p][/*][*][p]Lasers fired at the player by AI will now always play sound effect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]OTHER CHANGES[/h3][list][*][p] Enemy Elite Fighter is much faster and now fills an interceptor role[/p][/*][*][p]Laser turrets now turn faster and have a higher rate of fire[/p][/*][*][p]Missiles do slightly more damage than before[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bunch of new space backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]Squadron pilots are now randomized when starting a new campaign[/p][/*][*][p]Added more callsigns to the list for generated pilots[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot ranks have been reworked [/p][p]- Previously went Ensign > Pilot Officer > Sr Pilot > Flight Lt > Captain > Group Cmdr[/p][p]- New ranks are Midshipman > Ensign > Lieutenant > Captain > Commander > Commodore[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]There is now a flashing cursor when typing in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added some more AI combat dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]AI ships now make proper attack runs and break off when attacking large ships[/p][/*][*][p]Touched up hangar artwork again[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted engine exhaust trails on some ships[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the look of the player's energy bar[/p][/*][*][p]Player can no longer turn while charging jump drive[/p][/*][*][p]Capital ships have been made less maneuverable[/p][/*][*][p]Small changes to artwork on a few ships[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the names of some ship types[/p][p]- Brawler -> Missile Boat[/p][p]- Beamer (Allied) -> Beam Frigate[/p][p]- Beamer (Enemy) -> Destroyer[/p][p]- Scout Fighter -> Scout Craft[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Larger shockwave effect for cruisers when destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Light beam turrets do slightly more damage[/p][/*][*][p]Damage from warheads will now bleed through shields[/p][/*][*][p]Changed parameters for when and how often ace battles happen[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy ships now shoot a different color of laser than the Allied team[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Campaign now ends if you return to base without authorization[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]KNOWN BUGS[/h3][list][*][p]Turrets get reset when resuming a saved game mid-battle[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Updates Notes for Patch 1
notes.content:
Patch 1

NEW FEATURES

Flagship defence missions will now fail if Allied Cruiser is destroyed
 - New message letting player know they've been reassigned to a new ship when this happens
Lasers now fade away rather than abruptly disappear
Torpedoes now self-destruct rather than abruptly  disappear

BUG FIXES

Fixed main menu sometimes freezing when starting/continuing a campaign
Main menu options centered
Name no longer resets when starting a new game
Fixed issue with afterburner not recharging if holding afterburner key with no energy

OTHER CHANGES

Updated artwork on Allied Cruiser
Added more AI combat dialogue
Touched up hangar artwork

KNOWN BUGS

Fleets sometimes overlap slightly on the briefing map
